purpose: First-ever K9 native scope (not old K8 authority carried over): exercise the UNCHANGED production function pvc2/claim.issue locally, through actual Aiken BLS12-381 builtins, on the genuine public VK/proof in the adopted k8_fixture and a typed Transaction from pvc2/k9_consumer_builder. Exactly 7 Aiken unit cases with no fail annotations: 1 genuine positive True, N1/N2/N3 False through the pairing equation, and 3 structural Bool False guards (quantity 2, mismatched envelope name, wrong VK digest). No proof is generated and no proving key is used. The predicate is a local actual function consumer only; compiled wrapper, genuine hash, ledger ExUnits and Preprod are separate.
predicate: claim.issue(chosen_policy_id, vk, proof, tx) == True for the genuine envelope, and == False (observed via explicit !claim.issue(...) Bool assertions, never a fail-annotation shortcut) for N1 body-rederived digest, N2 context-rederived digest, N3 A/C-swapped proof, minted quantity 2, zero32 envelope token name, and zero32 vk_digest.

roots.freshLocalRootNote: Entirely public data. There is NO /w subtree. The operator refuses to start if this root already exists, never overwrites it and never writes into a pre-existing root or any existing root.

rootSequenceBeforeAnyRun: 1. Root materialises this fresh candidate into materializedOperatorDir by AST/JSON inspection only (Python ast parse of runner/operator.py; strict JSON parse of AUTH-CANDIDATE.json, EXECUTION-PROPOSAL.json, DESIGN-POSITIONS.json). No execution during materialisation. Source-only materialisation happens only after the exact source audit in step 2 records readiness; materialisation is not itself a run.

2. A fresh non-author performs a FULL fresh source/effect audit of the materialised bytes and records it in rootRecordsDir. This author is not that auditor and supplies no independent approval. Two agreeing runtime choices (the fresh non-author AGREE plus this author's FOR in DESIGN-POSITIONS.json) must exist before any AUTH.

3. Separately, the pending fresh K8 actual audit must be completed and recorded by root before any runtime AUTH is materialised. That future record does not exist yet: this source names the requirement but the operator contains no predicate guard over it and no hash for it is guessed. The spent K8 run itself is never restarted, its native-passed prefix is never rerun, and its counters are never reset.

4. For review custody, root fills exactly the one operatorSha256 placeholder in AUTH-CANDIDATE.json by LITERAL string replacement of OPERATOR_SHA256_TO_BE_FILLED_BY_ROOT_AFTER_MATERIALIZATION with the sha256 of the materialised runner/operator.py, preserving all other bytes; status remains CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED.

5. Only after fresh AGREE on the new K9 runtime clauses does root materialise a real AUTH.json by exactly two typed fills and no other change: operatorSha256 placeholder -> actual materialised hash, and status CANDIDATE_NOT_AUTHORIZED -> AUTHORIZED_EXACT_ONE_RUN. No runtime AUTH currently exists; none is created by this source.

6. Only after that exact new AUTH does root run the single launch command below, once, with zero retries. Every failure is preserved, followed by a mandatory fresh post-run actual audit before any part is called an actual result.
